title: documentation: back button is not working when on documentation page
body:
Load documentation, click on searchBox, click on back: nothing happens (expecting to go to top).

Load documentation, click on searchBox, click on setup, click on back: nothing happens (expecting to go to searchBox).

Weird as this should be a standard behavior of the browser (= nothing special to do to handle it). So we did something that broke it.

Maybe that since we are adding anchors dynamically (with name=..) then maybe it breaks. Dunno here.
